component.name: SimpleMail
SimpleMail 邮件客户端
component.summary: 本地优先的桌面邮件客户端

description.p: SimpleMail is a local-first desktop email client. Every message you sync is stored permanently on your own computer, so you can read and search your mail without a network connection.

ul.li: IMAP and POP3 receiving, SMTP sending; built-in presets for QQ Mail, 163, 126, Tencent Exmail, Sina, Gmail and Outlook
All messages are kept permanently in a local SQLite database; attachments are stored as separate files
Full-text search over subject, body, sender and recipients, with per-field search and relevance ranking
Import and export Foxmail mail archives (.fox files, .box + .ind folders, Storage directories)
Automatic filing rules, keyboard shortcuts, light and dark themes
Works completely offline; nothing is uploaded anywhere
Open source, released under the MIT license

description.p: SimpleMail 是一个本地优先的桌面邮件客户端。所有同步下来的邮件都永久保存在 你自己的电脑上，断网也能照常阅读和搜索。

ul.li: 支持 IMAP / POP3 收件与 SMTP 发信，内置 QQ 邮箱、163、126、腾讯企业邮、新浪、Gmail、Outlook 预设
邮件永久保存在本地 SQLite 数据库，附件单独存放，程序不会自动清理
基于 SQLite FTS5 的全文检索，可按发件人 / 收件人 / 主题 / 正文分别搜索并按匹配度排序
支持导入导出 Foxmail 邮件存档（.fox 文件、.box + .ind 目录、Storage 数据目录）
支持自动归类与自动删除规则、自定义键盘快捷键、浅色与深色主题
完全离线可用，不会向任何服务器上传数据
